goal: Create one isolated ordinary kernel with exact input provenance for the unchanged R107 instance; no new scenario or old matrix rerun
preferred_minimum: Freeze current platform Linux base plus exact existing overlay in a new source directory, add only the approved ordinary adapter there, use clean O outputs, reuse the verified DTB and original rootfs bytes, build one Image and one replacement firmware payload; compile the additive ordinary CLI separately against the same frozen UAPI

source_freeze.method: Read-only git archive of the exact full commit into a newly empty isolated source directory; apply a binary diff captured against HEAD; copy each relevant untracked lowrisc source recorded by git ls-files --others --exclude-standard. Capture full staged source file hashes, original HEAD/status, overlay before/after hashes and archive hash. Do not checkout/reset/stash/cherry-pick in production Linux.
source_freeze.new_adapter_change_scope: Only the necessary adapter/interface files selected by root; code review and coherent DMA/fence/ownership acceptance belong to root. Record the additional patch and hashes separately before build.
source_freeze.no_old_objects: A newly empty O= directory, not copied out/linux objects; this eliminates the historical incremental-object provenance gap.

toolchain.device_tree: DTC 1.6.1 available; no recompile needed when reusing exact aa9cdf4c DTB
toolchain.host: GNU Make 4.3; Python 3.10.12; flex 2.6.4; bison 3.8.2; gzip 1.10

config.baseline: Image-embedded.config (exact bytes from matching local Image)
changes_needed: CONFIG_INITRAMFS_SOURCE points to the frozen copy of the same rootfs.cpio, never mutable production out/rootfs.cpio
Choose a unique ordinary release via explicit CONFIG_LOCALVERSION/LOCALVERSION; record CONFIG_LOCALVERSION_AUTO behavior, preferably disable auto suffix for an archive source
Only additional symbols actually required by the adapter, reviewed and reported in full config diff
config.idma_linkage: linux/drivers/misc/Makefile:71 ties idma.o to CONFIG_RISCV_IOMMU, not a separate CONFIG_IDMA option
config.acceptance: After olddefconfig, inspect full config diff and extract the resulting Image IKCONFIG bytes to prove equality with the final frozen .config; record release, notes/build ID, ELF/Image/DTB/payload hashes and fixed KBUILD_BUILD_TIMESTAMP/USER/HOST/VERSION values.

initramfs.minimum: Copy these exact bytes to frozen input area; keep old network/SD helpers and old CLI ABI compatible. Build and transfer a new ordinary CLI separately. No need to recompile or execute the seven historical benchmark programs.
initramfs.when_repacking_required: If new CLI must be embedded or an incompatible legacy ABI change is explicitly accepted, freeze assets/rootfs-base.cpio, rootfs.py, all managed executables and data inputs from rootfs.py:8-29; rebuild only required binaries using the matching frozen UAPI, verify exact newc entries and hash the cpio. Such change is extra measured cost.

DTB.contract: Four idma devices/DIDs10..13; IOMMU 0x50010000; DT CPU50MHz/timebase25MHz declarations; physical clock acceptance remains root-owned.

loader_and_firmware.lloader_copy_rule: Copy only these tracked sources from the frozen kernel export into a new loader output directory, not old loader binaries. Build with IMAGE=new Image and DTB=frozen verified DTB, ARCH=rv64, TARGET=linux-rv64-cva6.
loader_and_firmware.opensbi_overlay: platform/fpga/ariane/platform.c sha256 7f87031601f04345456cb78ac5d6364c5eade71dd9e49e6d87c344f10397b659; capture current diff and freeze entire exported OpenSBI tree
loader_and_firmware.opensbi_command_interface: make -C frozen/opensbi O=new/opensbi CROSS_COMPILE=riscv64-linux-gnu- PLATFORM=fpga/ariane FW_PAYLOAD=y FW_PAYLOAD_PATH=new/lloader/linux-rv64-cva6.bin -j12
loader_and_firmware.layout: FW_TEXT_START=0x80000000; FW_PAYLOAD_OFFSET=0x200000; lloader aligns Image/DTB at 2MiB; runtime loader supplies a1 from its embedded DTB
loader_and_firmware.new_payload_size: unknown until built; must fit the existing 32MiB payload/SD convention

ABI.existing: RESEARCH2 caps ioctl0x10; COMPOSITION ABI1, 128 raw words, ioctl0x11; existing tests are not the R107 ordinary adapter
ABI.minimum: An additive, explicitly versioned ordinary UAPI with validated struct_size and no changed legacy ioctl/struct layout; compile new static RV64 CLI against the same frozen include/uapi/linux/idma.h. The interface must obey root ordinary-adapter-scope, including ownership/range/mapping/leaf/fence/cache/completion/guard checks.
ABI.not_proven: No ordinary adapter has been implemented, compiled or run in this child task; existing ELF symbol presence is not proof of the new interface.

why_not_existing_entrypoint_unmodified.kernel: scripts/platform.py:176-185 unconditionally repacks rootfs, overwrites out/linux/.config and writes production out/linux
why_not_existing_entrypoint_unmodified.build_update: --output-dir changes delivery/state destination only; scripts/build_update_software.py:272-273 still invokes the same production kernel()/firmware(). Use explicit isolated path commands or a reviewed small wrapper; do not treat this flag as build isolation.

proposed_execution_after_root_acceptance: Freeze exact kernel base/overlay and required ordinary adapter; capture and recheck input manifest
Copy verified config/rootfs/DTB to frozen inputs; set config rootfs path and unique release; inspect olddefconfig delta
One clean kernel Image build with ARCH=riscv/CROSS_COMPILE=riscv64-linux-gnu-/O=new output; freeze build metadata; extract config and hash all artifacts
One new lloader and one clean OpenSBI payload build from frozen sources; verify 32MiB size convention
Compile the new ordinary CLI separately from matching frozen UAPI; stage it with Image/config/DTB/payload/source manifest; no historical scientific test execution

Only root may perform authorized device update/reboot and match the same new boot to Image/ELF notes, release, directly read config and DTB; hardware identity/mode/clock/timing/route gates still apply before R107 recovery

necessary_cost.actual_this_child: Read-only evidence/hash/decompression/toolchain/version/ancestry checks; zero builds/source edits/device actions
necessary_cost.historical_cost_limit: cpn3-clean timestamp duration is incremental; not a fresh ordinary kernel cost estimate
necessary_cost.observed_storage: Linux working tree 7.1GiB including git; old out/linux390MiB; OpenSBI5.6MiB; old out/opensbi98MiB; filesystem available1.3TiB at read
necessary_cost.new_build_wall_time_and_storage: unknown; measure the actual clean kernel, CLI and firmware build separately
necessary_cost.runtime_cost_not_measured: ordinary adapter prepare/map/leaf/fence/cache/issue/done/verify/unmap/free and failure costs remain unmeasured; kernel provenance work cannot substitute them
